reason: The old closeout runtime is not promoted into RedCap 1.0. The useful 1.0 requirement is narrower: closeout, closure, pending-closure, closure-ledger, closeout receipt, and closeout summary artifacts may support evidence after changed runtime reality exists, but they must never complete a revival loop item by themselves.

bounded_term_scan.command_shape: rg -n -i closeout|close-out|closure|closing|wrap-up|sign-off|finishing|finalize|handoff|promise ledger over the four bounded sources

kept_for_1_0: Closeout-related evidence can support proof after changed reality exists.
Closeout and closure artifacts are explicitly classified as proof-only loop evidence unless paired with runtime, contract, knowledge, or RedCap command evidence.
A no-promote decision may preserve the design lesson without importing old closeout runtime.
not_promoted_for_1_0: Old closeout receipt and summary generation as completion authority.
Pending-closure and closure-ledger machinery as a task completion source.
Promise-ledger based closeout as a 1.0 loop exit mechanism.
